name: Digital Descent
tagline: Eighteen builders taking the digital era down with them.

facts.note: Pointercrate names the verifier “combi”; the level's own description says “Verified by Combined”, and that is the name used here. Ranked #403 on the Demonlist as of 30 August 2026. GDBrowser reports 65,535 objects, the API's 16-bit ceiling rather than a real count.

spotlight.sub: ViPriN hosted it and Combined verified it. The level's description: the digital era is going down.

voice.hook: Eighteen names, and a level about something ending.
voice.why:
Digital Descent is a ViPriN megacollab with eighteen credited builders, including KrmaL, Manix648, Serponge and LazerBlitz. It runs on hyperdemented's Carnivores and it is XL length.

The level's own description sets it out: revolution is not always made by the ones who rule, and this time the digital era is going down. Combined verified it.
